```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Packages (install once in the Console if needed):
# install.packages(c("haven", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2"))
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load the Case 31 survey data (SPSS file)
efcu <- read_sav("data/Case_31_Data_efcu.sav") |>
  zap_labels()   # keep the numeric codes, drop SPSS label attributes

# Pink neutral palette to match the website
rose  <- "#B5646F"
blush <- "#F2D7D9"
sand  <- "#D9C7B8"
cocoa <- "#4A3F3F"

theme_site <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = cocoa),
    axis.text = element_text(color = cocoa),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Location label used on several charts (q38: 1 = yes, 2 = no)
efcu <- efcu |>
  mutate(location = if_else(q38 == 1, "Near headquarters", "Elsewhere"))
```

# Overview

## Row {height="25%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Members surveyed"
list(icon = "people", color = blush, value = nrow(efcu))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Employee rating (out of 5)"
list(icon = "emoji-smile", color = blush,
     value = round(mean(efcu$employeeperformance, na.rm = TRUE), 2))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Rate EFCU good or excellent"
pct_good <- mean(efcu$q37 %in% c(1, 2)) * 100
list(icon = "star", color = blush, value = paste0(round(pct_good), "%"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Currently have an EFCU loan"
pct_loan <- mean(efcu$q27 == 1) * 100
list(icon = "cash-coin", color = blush, value = paste0(round(pct_loan), "%"))
```

## Row {height="75%"}

```{r}
#| title: "How members rate EFCU employees (1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree)"
efcu |>
  summarise(
    Courteous    = mean(q3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Helpful      = mean(q4, na.rm = TRUE),
    Professional = mean(q5, na.rm = TRUE),
    Available    = mean(q6, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "item", values_to = "mean") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(item, mean), y = mean)) +
  geom_col(fill = rose, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean, 2)), hjust = -0.2, color = cocoa) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(1, 5.3)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average agreement") +
  theme_site
```

```{r}
#| title: "Overall rating of the credit union"
efcu |>
  filter(!is.na(q37)) |>
  mutate(rating = factor(q37, levels = 1:5,
                         labels = c("Excellent", "Good", "Average",
                                    "Poor", "Very poor"))) |>
  count(rating, .drop = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rating, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = rose, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.4, color = cocoa) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of members") +
  theme_site
```

# Service Awareness

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Awareness and use of EFCU services"
services <- c(
  q13 = "Regular share account", q14 = "Special subaccounts",
  q15 = "Christmas club",        q16 = "IRA",
  q17 = "MasterCard",            q18 = "Signature loans",
  q19 = "New car loans",         q20 = "Late model car loans",
  q21 = "Older model car loans", q22 = "Household goods loans",
  q23 = "Recreational loans",    q24 = "Share collateralized loans",
  q25 = "IRA loans",             q26 = "Line of credit"
)

awareness <- efcu |>
  select(all_of(names(services))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "q", values_to = "code") |>
  filter(code %in% 1:3) |>
  mutate(
    service = services[q],
    status = factor(code, levels = c(3, 2, 1),
                    labels = c("Unaware of service",
                               "Aware, not used",
                               "Aware and used"))
  )

# Order services by how many members are unaware
order_unaware <- awareness |>
  group_by(service) |>
  summarise(unaware = mean(code == 3)) |>
  arrange(unaware) |>
  pull(service)

awareness |>
  mutate(service = factor(service, levels = order_unaware)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = service, fill = status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(rose, sand, blush)) +
  labs(x = "Share of members", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_site
```

## Row {height="20%"}

::: {.card title="How to read this"}
Services near the top of the chart have the most members who did not know they existed. Those are the best candidates for member communication, since people cannot use a loan product they have never heard of.
:::

# Borrowing & Location

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Loan attitudes by member location (1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree)"
efcu |>
  group_by(location) |>
  summarise(
    `Rates lower than others`  = mean(q30, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Keeps info confidential`  = mean(q31, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Is prompt`                = mean(q32, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Meets member needs`       = mean(q33, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Loan applications simple` = mean(q34, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-location, names_to = "item", values_to = "mean") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = item, y = mean, fill = location)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(1, 5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(sand, rose)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average agreement", fill = NULL) +
  theme_site
```

```{r}
#| title: "Share of members with an EFCU loan, by location"
efcu |>
  group_by(location) |>
  summarise(pct_loan = mean(q27 == 1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = location, y = pct_loan)) +
  geom_col(fill = rose, width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(pct_loan, accuracy = 1)),
            vjust = -0.4, color = cocoa) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Members with a loan") +
  theme_site
```

## Row {height="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Opinion of EFCU loan rates"
efcu |>
  filter(q8 %in% 1:5) |>
  mutate(opinion = factor(q8, levels = 1:5,
                          labels = c("Very high", "High", "Average",
                                     "Low", "Very low"))) |>
  count(opinion, .drop = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = opinion, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = rose, width = 0.6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of members") +
  theme_site
```

# About the Data

::: {.card title="About this dashboard"}
**Data:** Case 31, Employees Federal Credit Union (EFCU) member opinion survey, 128 respondents. Used as practice data for the MSDM Culminating Experience Project while client data is still being collected.

**Business question:** The EFCU board wants to know why members are not borrowing from the credit union, how aware members are of its services, how they feel about employees, and whether members near headquarters feel differently from members who live elsewhere.

**Built with:** R (haven, dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2) and Quarto's `dashboard` format.

**Note:** These are descriptive summaries only. Formal hypothesis tests come later in the course.
:::
